scope: Current production closure 11e4062, compact F32 internal quality endpoints on one 32-logical-CPU boot. Not a full worker curve, old/new comparison, I16, external-reference or R1 certification.
order: Case order river,turn,flop; block0 warmup then blocks1,2,3 measured. Rotate [1,16,32] left by (case-index + block) modulo3. Each measured worker occupies each ordinal position once within each case. All36 runs retained; warmups must pass every correctness check but never enter performance statistics. No pilot or count selection.
quality: First check with finite unclamped NashConv <= the fixed case target, within unchanged exact-mass04 caps/cadences. Full stopping trajectory numeric bits, final EV/BR/NC bits, retained hand IDs, all-node strategy/CFV canonical bytes and complete compact F32 state bytes must agree across workers and repeats. No old/new equivalence or external accuracy claim. The River input has nonzero rake; its NC is an internal diagnostic, not zero-sum certification.

foundation.reuse: Verify the original eight exact-mass04 validation stages and raw identities. This is historical source-identical validation, not a workspace rerun on the new host. Preserve original dirty-base manifest; all current production/Cargo pins must equal 11e4062. The unchanged full snapshot also contains the validated research benchmark.

measurement: Single fresh release benchmark binary built on the same32-CPU boot and unchanged host/cgroup as every sample. Full affinity, CPU quota unlimited or >=32, outerMemoryMax<=12GiB, swap0, CPUWeight100. Solve timer includes all stopping EV/BR checks; setup and final query/capture/output remain separate. Report all medians, speedups and32/16 slowdowns; no forced speedup threshold. Native RSS may inherit parent highwater; native and sampled RSS are separate descriptive counters, with no memory reduction claim.
failure: Every sample must fit300s+20s before the fixed absolute deadline; build must fit1200s+20s. No retries, resumed execution, replacement, target changes or timeout successes. Any process, identity, containment, quality or artifact failure stops execution, retains available rawbytes and marks the exact remaining suffix skipped. VM lifecycle/reservation/deletion and an earlier recovery margin remain caller obligations.
